The day of the Arima Kinen. Haru Urara 
seems rather confused by the "bubbling" 
and "restless" feelings inside her.

The Trainer told Haru Urara that this was 
what it meant to run "for real." Having 
understood the meaning of running "for 
real," Haru Urara—

With a boiling, earnest passion held close 
to their heart, they charged into the race 
aiming for nothing less than 1st place.
